subject: Proposition 2.5 Override Questions
overview: City Councilor Anna Callahan presented the arguments for voting yes on ballot questions 6, 7, and 8 to address long-term municipal underfunding and support local services.

items.title: Presentation on Ballot Questions 6, 7, and 8
items.summary: Councilor Anna Callahan presented comparative spending data and budget breakdowns to argue that passing Proposition 2.5 overrides is necessary to fund public schools and road repairs.
